data.title: Request to submit vacation preferences for the first half of 2027
data.summary: The employer, Druckerei Beispiellahn GmbH (Personalabteilung), asks Johanna Beispielacker to enter her vacation preferences for January to June 2027 into a list in the break room or the staff portal, within 10 working days of the letter date (18 November 2026).
data.explanation: Your employer is planning work shifts for early 2027 and wants to know when you'd like to take vacation during that period. Find the list in the break room or the staff portal and enter your preferred vacation dates by the deadline shown by the app (counted in working days, Monday to Friday excluding public holidays, from the letter's date). If you miss it, the employer may plan shifts without taking your preferences into account, though the letter doesn't state a specific penalty.
